hypothesis.name: Extended thinking framework improves scene quality
hypothesis.description: Adding structured pre-generation reasoning (character audit, consequence trace, voice verification) should improve Magic Score and reduce slop

variable.baseline: Standard agent prompts without thinking framework

hypothesis.prediction: Magic Score improves by >= 10%, Anti-Slop improves by >= 15%

messageFlow.content: Create a dark fantasy world. A kingdom where magic is powered by human memory - every spell erases a memory from the caster. The ruling class hoards illiterate peasants as 'fuel'. Use update_world_bible.

Create two characters: 1) Magistrate Venn, who runs the memory farms but has been secretly shielding a child from harvesting. 2) The child, Pip, 12 years old, who has started to learn forbidden reading in secret.
Write the scene where Pip accidentally casts a spell using a word she read, and Venn must decide whether to report her or hide the evidence. This is a decision beat.
Now write the consequence: someone witnessed what happened. Write the next scene.
